description: Sanctions screening against the US Treasury OFAC SDN and Consolidated lists. Send a person, company or vessel name (fuzzy match on names and aliases, with scores) or a crypto wallet address (exact match against addresses OFAC lists). Returns match or no_match, entries with program, list and score, and provenance: each list file's URL, refresh time and SHA-256. Use before a payment or onboarding. A screening aid, not a compliance determination. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

address.description: Crypto wallet address to screen (exact match). Send name or address.

min_score.description: Lowest name similarity to report, 0.80 to 1.

name.description: Person, company or vessel name to screen (fuzzy match).

type.description: Only entries of this type (name screening).
